## Engine-specific checklist (when applicable)

- [ ] Upstream project, version and license reviewed.
- [ ] Supported input/output and capability category documented.
- [ ] Isolation, network requirements and resource limits documented.
- [ ] Raw output and logs retained independently.
- [ ] Normalized results include provenance and evidence.
- [ ] Known limitations and benchmark results documented.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No proprietary artifacts, credentials, cookies or private captures committed.
- [ ] No unauthorized target testing or bypass capability added.
- [ ] Scope and authorization behavior reviewed where network access is involved.
